trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: At least one target sequence in a batch has length zero (label_sizes contains 0) and backward is requested after the forward pass.

bug_oracle.description: CTCLoss produces an incorrect gradient when at least one target sequence is empty.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Mutate target sequence lengths to include zero-length targets across a batch while keeping log_probs shapes valid.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct CTC log_probs tensors with shape [T, N, C], integer target tensors, and label_sizes containing zeros for selected batch elements.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Ensure label_sizes values do not exceed input length, set one or more label_sizes to 0, and keep other CTC input constraints satisfied.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Run torch.nn.functional.ctc_loss forward, then call backward on the loss, and inspect gradients with respect to log_probs.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Compare gradients for empty-target cases to a differentiable reference or finite-difference baseline; any material mismatch is treated as an incorrect gradient.
